summary: The dhcp_probe role meets P1's outcome. It runs a 3-min relay-style DISCOVER from srviac to 10.2.1.10 and records success, duration and timestamp through node-exporter's textfile collector. giaddr renders to 10.1.0.45 and the unit tests pass. One advisory finding: check mode skips the timer task.

findings.summary: dhcp_probe's timer enable/start task is skipped under --check on every run, so dry runs never show the timer's state or its drift
